name: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia
positioning: Gran Melia hotel in Santo Tomas on Menorca that arranges private tastings and workshop visits built around Menorcan products
best_for: Travelers who want hands-on tastings of Menorcan products such as cheese, wine, oil and saffron
Small groups who want a private tour of Menorca in a Land Rover Defender

facts.text: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia is in Santo Tomas, on the island of Menorca, Spain.
The hotel's Personal Taste experience lets guests taste typical Menorcan products and discover the island's workshops.
Guests can choose an oil or saffron tasting that includes a visit to the plantation.
Guests can visit a Menorcan wine and vermouth cellar, with a tasting included.
Guests can enjoy a tasting of the island's artisan beers.
The experience includes up to two dining experiences to choose from, plus the Land Rover Defender trip.
The experience takes a maximum of 8 people.
Bookings and detailed information come through the hotel reservations team, by phone or email.

highlights.text: Guests can tour Menorca in a Land Rover Defender to discover traditional island products.
Guests can make their own cheese.
These private experiences belong to the hotel's collection called The art of good living.

considerations.text: The Personal Taste experience must be booked at least 48 hours in advance and is subject to availability.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
